title: Egyptian-Style Aromatic Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Savory and aromatic flavors come together in this quick and easy chicken stir-fry, inspired by Egyptian cuisine. Serve over rice or noodles for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: aromatic
ingredients.notes: such as onions and bell peppers

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add aromatics and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add Egyptian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Return chicken to skillet and stir in cheddar cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
